results.Notes: Full canonical bank comparison over all 327 records. Closest bank comparisons: MA-Q-0273 (0.11), MA-Q-0220 (0.11), MA-Q-0283 (0.10). Closest tranche siblings: MA-Q-0315 (0.12), MA-Q-0326 (0.09). Distinct from every other bank record on the legal discrimination it turns on. TRANCHE-LEVEL OBSERVATION recorded for the controller rather than against this item. Two answer-distribution patterns run through BATCH3-B3C and neither is visible to the repository gates. First, option E is a keyed-correct selection in 11 of the 12 SATA items, every one except MA-Q-0324, against a base rate of 0.49 across the 112 SATA items in the rest of the bank; on the SBA side E is keyed 7 times in 21, against 29 in 181 for the rest of the bank. Second, the tranche contains no three-correct SATA item at all, its SATA key sizes being seven twos and five fours, whereas the rest of the bank is modally three (1/24/57/40 for one through four). The second pattern is invariant under the delivery-layer choice shuffle in site/shuffle.js and is therefore exploitable directly: a candidate practising this tranche learns that a B3-C SATA answer set is never three statements. scripts/check_structural_patterns.py does not catch either pattern because sata_key_max_share measures the share of a whole answer set such as ABCE and sata_correct_count_max_share measures the count histogram, both computed bank-wide over 317 items, so a 33-item tranche skew is diluted below threshold; scripts/check_answer_distribution.py measures SBA keys only. This is a recurrence: CLAUDE-FRESH-B3B recorded the same class of tranche-level keyed-position concentration against BATCH3-B3B, so the authoring pipeline has now produced it twice and the repository's own note that 'choice shuffling does not excuse a structurally biased canonical bank' applies. Recommended remediation is a tranche-level rebalance of which statements are placed true and a per-tranche distribution gate, not a change to any individual item's law.

Full canonical bank comparison over all 327 records. Closest bank comparisons: MA-Q-0213 (0.18), MA-Q-0282 (0.12), MA-Q-0281 (0.12). Closest tranche siblings: MA-Q-0316 (0.15), MA-Q-0310 (0.14). REALISM FAIL on distinct_from_bank. The keyed proposition is that the toll-free number for off-site delivery must be printed on a label affixed to each container under M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 21A. That exact proposition is already the keyed answer of released MA-Q-0213 (rule MA-COUNSELING-REMOTE-DELIVERY), whose key A reads 'Print the toll-free service number on a label affixed to each prescription drug container.' Worse, MA-Q-0213 distractor C ('Include the number only on the delivery receipt that the patient signs') is materially the fact pattern of this stem, so this item converts a distractor of an existing released item into a stem and re-keys the same sentence of the same statute. A candidate who has answered MA-Q-0213 answers this without further knowledge. The tranche gains no new discrimination. Required change: Re-aim the item at a limb of s. 21A that the bank does not already own. The untested limb is the offer-method rule in the second paragraph, that the offer shall be made face to face or by telephone 'except when the patient's needs or availability require an alternative method of counseling', which is a conditional escape rather than an open choice of method. Alternatively retire the item, since MA-Q-0213 already covers the container-label rule.

Full canonical bank comparison over all 327 records. Closest bank comparisons: MA-Q-0086 (0.15), MA-Q-0281 (0.12), MA-Q-0031 (0.12). Closest tranche siblings: MA-Q-0309 (0.14), MA-Q-0316 (0.12). REALISM FAIL on distinct_from_bank. The item's entire discrimination is that the absence of a record of a failure to accept the offer to counsel creates a presumption that counselling was provided, under M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 21A. That proposition already exists in the bank as a scored, keyed-correct option of released MA-Q-0086 (rules MA-COUNSELING, MA-COUNSELING-DOCUMENTATION), whose option C reads 'If there is no record that the patient failed to accept the offer, the statute creates a presumption that counseling was provided.' MA-Q-0086 option C is not compound and states the presumption and its direction completely, so isolating it into a single-best-answer item adds no discrimination the bank lacks; it only changes the response format. Required change: Re-aim at a proposition of s. 21A that MA-Q-0086 does not already key. Candidates include the evidentiary consequence of the pharmacy's chosen record system, or the inpatient/nursing-home carve-out in the final paragraph of s. 21A, neither of which is keyed anywhere in the bank. Alternatively retire the item.
